book: Three-book Latin treatise, De redemtione humani generis per Christum (Heidelberg 1592) by Jacobus Kimedoncius, with a dedicatory epistle to Count Palatine Frederick IV, numbered chapters in each liber, a separately headed Liber de praedestinatione divina with its own chapters, and back matter of indexes and errata.
